newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil tax officials clear navy of smuggling claim.
newsitem.headline: Brazil tax officials clear navy of smuggling claim.

text.p: Brazilian tax officials on Thursday said they had found no evidence to back up claims that the country's navy was involved in large-scale smuggling.

However, a swoop by Brazilian tax officials on a navy vessel that a television station alleged was carrying contraband did result in fines of about $55,000 for 160 sailors who exceeded their duty-free limits.
"From the inspection, it should be noted that the quantity and type of goods ... do not indicate commercial activity," the Federal Tax Secretariat said in a statement.
Globo television ran a series of reports in June suggesting that navy warships were being used by a smuggling ring to bring large amounts of contraband goods into the country.

Brazil's Navy Ministry said the investigation cleared its reputation. "We have all had to explain to family, friends and neighbours what was going on, and, sometimes, we had to endure their suspicion," the ministry said in a statement.
